title: RankingEvidenceObservation
description: V3.7 -- the clean, minimal external enrichment interface for one factual Google-visibility observation that Claude cannot reliably obtain itself (a live Maps/organic rank check). Consumed by scripts/import_ranking_observation.py, which normalizes it into the existing schemas/ranking_snapshot.schema.json storage at data/rankings/<market_id>.csv -- the same file scripts/reevaluate_needs_enrichment.py and (unchanged) scripts/rescore_leads.py read. This schema intentionally exposes only the fields a human or an external tool (Google Maps itself, or a SEMrush export a human is transcribing) can actually supply -- it is never produced by Claude, and never by any script in this repository automatically.

business_name.description: Needed (with or in place of domain) to match this observation to a prospect record -- see scripts/rescore_leads.py: find_ranking_match

domain.description: Preferred match key over business_name when known -- more reliable than a name match

maps_position.description: Exact observed local-pack/Maps rank for `query` at `location`. Null means genuinely not observed -- NEVER write null-because-not-ranked-in-top-N as a specific number just past the captured range, and never leave this unset to imply a poor position. UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN until real evidence is supplied.

organic_position.description: Exact observed organic SERP rank for `query`. Same null-means-unknown rule as maps_position.

query.description: The exact search query/keyword this observation is for -- e.g. 'emergency roof repair columbus oh'. Never blend multiple queries into one observation.

location.description: Either a market_id slug (e.g. 'roofing-columbus-oh', matching data/markets/<market_id>/) or a plain 'City, ST' string -- scripts/import_ranking_observation.py resolves either form to the canonical market_id using the prospect's own niche/city/state.

observed_at.description: When this rank was actually observed/checked -- not the import time. Freshness checks (config/limits.yaml: ranking_freshness_days) key off this.

source.description: Real provenance of the observation -- a human manually checking Google Maps/Search, or a fact transcribed from a real Semrush export/screenshot. Never 'estimated' or 'assumed'.

notes.description: Free-text context, e.g. device/location used for the manual check, or why only one of maps_position/organic_position was observed
